note: Read Only Mode blocks form submissions site-wide when enabled while keeping the site readable. All state lives in the readonlymode.settings config object (enabled 0/1, url redirect, messages.default/not_saved, forms.default.edit/view shipped allow-lists, forms.additional.edit/view newline-separated custom form IDs with * wildcards). Its UI is grafted onto the core Maintenance mode form (system.site_maintenance_mode). It defines two permissions: 'readonlymode access forms' (bypass) and 'readonlymode access messages' (see notices). No Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that config object read/written via drush cget/cset.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the readonlymode module, how do I turn Read Only Mode on, and where is that stored? Name the config object/key and the admin form it is attached to.
evals.expected_output: Set readonlymode.settings:enabled to 1 (drush cset readonlymode.settings enabled 1). The UI is a 'Read Only Mode' section on the core Maintenance mode form (system.site_maintenance_mode, /admin/config/development/maintenance).

evals.prompt: What permissions does the Drupal readonlymode module define and what does each one do?
evals.expected_output: 'readonlymode access forms' lets a user bypass the lock and submit any form while Read Only Mode is on; 'readonlymode access messages' controls who sees the read-only notices/warnings.

evals.prompt: While readonlymode is enabled, how can I let a specific set of forms (e.g. all webforms) still be submitted? Which config value controls that and what format does it use?
evals.expected_output: Add form IDs to readonlymode.settings:forms.additional.edit (submittable) or forms.additional.view (view-only). It is a newline-separated string and supports the * wildcard, e.g. webform* matches all webforms.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Read Only Mode has been configured. Inspect the live readonlymode configuration and report whether it is enabled and what redirect path (if any) is set for blocked edit attempts.
evals.expected_output: Read Only Mode is enabled (readonlymode.settings:enabled = 1) and the redirect url is /rom-under-maintenance (drush cget readonlymode.settings).

evals.prompt: This site's readonlymode configuration has one extra custom form added to the list of forms that may still be submitted while Read Only Mode is active. Inspect the live configuration and give that form ID.
evals.expected_output: The custom allowed form is rom_probe_widget_form, in readonlymode.settings:forms.additional.edit.

evals.prompt: Using the readonlymode module, put this Drupal site into Read Only Mode so that content changes are blocked. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
evals.expected_output: readonlymode.settings:enabled is set to 1 (e.g. drush cset readonlymode.settings enabled 1).

evals.prompt: On this site, configure the readonlymode module so that the form with ID contact_message_feedback_form is allowed to be submitted even while Read Only Mode is active. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: readonlymode.settings:forms.additional.edit contains contact_message_feedback_form (newline-separated allow-list of submittable forms).
